verdict.rationale: Railway documents instant rollback to any previous deployment version, per-PR preview environments (review before merge), and unlimited environments for parallel work, which map loosely onto 'version, review, rollback' for deployments treated as automations. However, there is no explicit versioning/audit trail UI for automation logic itself, no diff/history view, and no dedicated 'automation' concept distinct from service deployments. Missing for 10: explicit automation/workflow versioning history, diff-based review tooling, and independent confirmation that rollback works reliably for complex multi-service automations.
